contract: ../header-consistency.md: retain the approved illustrated header family across all 117 authenticated route files and seven existing loading boundaries, preserve response/permission/data contracts, enforce Items typography and compact spacing, and verify real production-browser desktop/mobile/Arabic RTL renders. The new upstream Event Integration fallback uses the existing illustrated IntegrationWorkbenchHeader wrapper; the CI guard validates that wrapper without changing its rendering.

accessibility.evidence: Real Chromium checks exercised focus and Enter on back navigation, retry with an observed server refresh, return to Dashboard, existing tab keyboard behavior, and mobile header-link targets of at least 44px. The separate 16-case browser suite verifies tab/form lifecycle, LTR/RTL keys, help overlays and restored focus. Reduced-motion loading has animation-name:none. Decorative SVGs remain aria-hidden and pointer-events:none. Against the mint gradient endpoints, the retained foreground, muted and link colors have minimum calculated ratios of 12.63:1, 4.77:1 and 7.11:1; the artwork was also visually inspected. This is targeted verification, not a complete pixel-contrast, axe or assistive-technology audit.

responsive.evidence: Actual production screens were captured in English at 1920x900, 1366x768 and 375x900 and Arabic RTL at 1366x768 and 375x900. Assertions verify one section banner, 20px/28px titles, 14px/20px navigation/subtitles/actions, 12px/16px disclosures, matching locale font families, 14px desktop inputs and 16px/24px mobile inputs, 16px/24px semibold compact evidence-card values, a tagline-to-title gap no greater than 12px, contained titles/actions and locally scrolling tabs. The broader responsive suite passed at 375, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px, including Dashboard-to-Items navigation and sidebar type/icon checks. Long part identifiers wrap without shrinking their type.

loading.evidence: Real throttled Imports history and creation reloads retain their section artwork at y=0 with a 100px desktop backdrop. Both existing fallback components are exercised without inserting new ancestor streaming boundaries or adding tabs. The existing policy-list and Settings loading checks also ran in the full browser sweep.

empty.evidence: Fresh local organizations and empty master-data sublists keep the same section header and the existing truthful empty state and authorized creation/import actions. No dashboard or planning values are fabricated.

error.evidence: An intentionally incomplete local policy-evidence fixture displays translated generic Arabic recovery under the forecast pattern. Retry produces another server response and the Dashboard return link works; exception details are not rendered. Invalid batch selection branches retain their section heading. Matched missing Item routes retain HTTP 404, the visible code and translated recovery.

partial.reason: The shared header loads no operational dataset and adds no calculations. Its title and metadata arrive with the existing page response; partial planning evidence remains owned by unchanged report components. This presentation change defines no new partial-data behavior.

success.evidence: Existing create/edit/delete, import, policy review, independent purchase/transfer review and saved-evidence workflows were exercised in the full sweep and affected-suite reruns. Back/source destinations, forms and actions remain functional under the new header. The merged repeated-download and event read API checks also pass in the rerun.

permission.evidence: Read-only viewers retain their allowed master data and Settings panels without administrative actions. Hidden-record/branch checks retain the existing 404 behavior and no record details. Imports stay hidden from viewers and their report API still refuses access. Tenant/location filtering and all RPC contracts are unchanged by this PR.
